connector.name: Soldefi MCP
connector.registryDescription: Solana DeFi risk intel over x402: rug/honeypot scans, pool analysis, wash-filtered pools.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package soldefi-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the thomenz account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: base58 or JSON-array secret key of a DEDICATED Solana wallet holding USDC (pays per call). Configure this and/or EVM_PRIVATE_KEY; the x402 layer settles on whichever rail the 402 advertises. Paid tools return 402 without one; the free validate_mint tool still works.

env.name: EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: 0x private key of a DEDICATED wallet holding USDC on Base (pays per call). Configure this and/or SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY; the x402 layer settles on whichever rail the 402 advertises. Paid tools return 402 without one; the free validate_mint tool still works.

env.name: SOLANA_RPC_URL
env.description: Optional Solana RPC override used to build the payment (e.g. a Helius URL). Only read when SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY is set.

env.name: SOLDEFI_BASE_URL
env.description: Base URL of a soldefi Worker. Defaults to the hosted production API (https://soldefi.thomenz.me).

env.name: X402_NETWORK
env.description: Set to 'base-sepolia' to pay on testnet, which switches BOTH rails (Solana devnet + Base Sepolia). Any other value, including unset, pays on mainnet.
